description:
Crab Shack

Requires MagicLib

Requires GraphicsLib

Additional content when enabled with the following mods :

Secrets of the Frontier

Second in Command

Nexerelin

YE OLDE DOWNLOAD LINK

(also supports Lunalib's version checker)

An unserious mod that contains whatever I happened to think was funny at the moment. Has quests, ships with weird mechanics, lots of dialog, special items, boss fights, exploration content, fishing, etc...

A non-exhaustive list of previews below

Exploration stuff

Spoiler
Fall into the trap of a deadly Houndslaught, gain an unlikely ally after defeating a colony of giant alien spiders, use metamorphic fluid to duplicate said ally, respond to an ancient distress signal to aid in combat against an abyssal threat, or accidentally install adware onto your Tripad. The possibilities are... rather limited, actually. But there's a decent amount of stuff.
Gene Splicers
Spoiler
Find Gene Splicers out in the fringes, which let you move skills between officers. Some even come pre-filled!

... but be careful, don't just do any drugs you find lying around. Not all the skills they have are good!

Giant Alien Spiders
Spoiler
Giant alien spiders are no joke! Fortunately, your marines are professionals and have no time for jokes.
Just what would happen if you kept this egg around?

Strange Canisters
Spoiler
Might want the PPE on for this one.

Other varying self-contained encounters as small setpieces

... and more!

Fishing

Spoiler
Adds a fishing minigame with associated systems. You can learn to fish at Fikenhild.

Look at your fishing catalogue to plan your excursion, fish the fish, and cook them into one of many unique meals with custom effects.

Or maybe you just want to watch them swim around in your fish tank at the end of a long day?

Ships

Spoiler
Archipelago
Spoiler
Some advertisement drone that exists as one of the only remnants of a corporation that fell apart after the Collapse.
Rumored to be spotted in the fringes nearby water worlds.

Can operate unmanned, but comes with onboard vomit buckets in the event it's piloted by a captain. Hold on tight!

Houndslaught
Spoiler
Fourty hounds strong with a nasty bite. Able to disperse its Hound modules like a swarm of bats to reposition as needed.

Comes with an Alex-approved Alviss version.

Fenrir
Spoiler
Too many hounds? I understand. Here's something more reasonable.

Ziggurat Mk.I
Spoiler
Horrific love child of an onslaught and a certain phase ship. Maybe you can get it by talking to a certain Company director while its parents are in your fleet?

Longquest
Spoiler
Who needs engines with arms like these? Note: may require assembly

... and more

Quests

Spoiler
Go cave diving to reunite a mechanic with her friend.

Help a Luddic Path engineer experiment on AI, and maybe cause more trouble for the sector in the process.

Give your friend moral support as they arm wrestle the pirate queen.

... and more!

Secrets of the Frontier: Boss fight

Spoiler
Adds the Radiance from Hollow Knight as a boss you can fight using Sierra.
You can unlock the main menu version of the fight after doing the associated quest in the campaign.

Second-in-Command: BUFFMEAT Aptitude

Spoiler
Adds the BUFFMEAT aptitude for a recruitable character in the mod.
Highly benefits crewed low tech ships, especially those that fight at close range.

Nexerlin: New custom start, background

Spoiler
Assimilation Custom Start
Spoiler
Start the game under Remnant commission as an AI fleet commander. You will have access to any Remnant nexus as a dock and can use them to print new ships.

You can teach new automated ships to the Remnants by feeding them to a Nexus.
Intended for an AI fleet roleplaying playthrough. You will be locked to hostile with most factions.

Trash Man Background
Spoiler
Gives all your ships red barcodes.

Miscellanous Features

Spoiler
Anything I thought was interesting enough to put on the forum post and doesn't spoil something, but isn't directly related to any other features.
Experimental-C
Spoiler
Lunalib toggle that allows you to use hullmods which do more experimental things. Rip a ship system out of one ship and put it in another, give a ship a makeshift phase cloak or even shunt the phase out of an existing phase ship so you can give it a shield.

Stelnet Community
Spoiler
Curious about the current happenings in the Sector? Doomscroll through the Stelnet Community page!
Currently WIP but has ~40 written posts, some triggered by doing specific things (using a gate in a colonized system, winning the duel in Princess of Persia, etc) or enabling specific mods (Tahlan Shipworks, Secrets of the Frontier, Volkov Industrial Conglomerate, etc).

If these previews fail to convince you, please view this collection of curated user reviews.

Spoiler

FAQ

Can it be added to existing saves?
Yes. Some things may behave strangely if added very late into a playthrough, but nothing game breaking.

How do I engage with the content?
Just do whatever you normally do. There's no central faction or big feature of the mod that demands attention... but if you don't like that answer, explore the fringes, check bars, maybe stop by Fikenhild?
There's also a mod guide attached that has steps on how to find (almost) everything, if you don't care for spoilers.

Is this mod balanced?
Not at all!

Unserious? How bad is it?
Yes. Basically the Wild Wasteland of starsector. This is firmly a meme mod. If you value immersion, don't install this.

Is this mod finished?
No. The current features are relatively complete, although you might run into missing dialog here and there. It'll work on it as I can.

Stability?
The mod shouldn't cause notable lag, I run a profiler on everything. Crashes should be fairly unlikely, but I may have missed some cross-mod wonk.

TriOS says the mod uses 8 billion megabytes of VRAM!
Yeah. The mod loads and unloads sprites as needed, so the actual usage won't be as high. A specific boss fight listed above is responsible for this. if you're skirting your VRAM limit as is you may be unable to fight that boss.
Typical vram usage for the mod is ~200 megabytes

RECENT CHANGELOG
For full changelog, see attached changelog.txt with the mod

Spoiler
Version 0.5.511

Fixed listener crash when interacting with nothing

Version 0.5.51

Fixed a few crashes that would happen on Linux

Version 0.5.5

Save compatible, but updating in an existing save may cause some non-important dialog to display incorrectly.

Added a new flavor feature you can mess around with. Added a related bar event that introduces you to it.
It's unfinished at the moment, as in there's not a lot to interact with. I will add more to it as time goes on.

Added a new type of AI core that appears during the Forever War mini-quest

Longquest is now easier to find
- finding one of its arms automatically gives you the location of the wreck if you haven't recovered it yet (new save only)
- wreck can be detected further away (new save only)
- dialog modified to make it more obvious of where it could appear

Locus is now easier to find
- wreck can be detected further away and emits a large gold sensor ping (new save only)
In the future it may be part of a quest/background, not sure for now

Locus' unique gauge now builds faster and scales harder off of investment
- formula changed to always have a base 5 energy generation, then adds on gain from flux
- flux per extra energy point reduced (350 -> 300)
- max generation per use increased (25 -> 34)
effectively you'll build pangenesis uses faster and scale much harder off of high investment into caps
for the max bonus you will need skills + hullmods (such as flux coil + technology skills)
should feel suitably super now and less like herding cats ALL the time, although you will still need to do so to get your freaky mode

"Well Fed" can no longer be removed by gene splicers

Reduced chaining on Longquest zapper weapon to 8 max jumps (it was 20 jumps before, insane modslop)

Updated mod guide with some missing stuff

Probably fixed explosion immunity not working on sanctified cores when under very high timeflow and speed
Fixed crossmod crash related to generating alien spider campaign interaction

Version 0.5.4
Small update, just some adjustments

Added a lunalib setting to change fishing difficulty
Added lunalib settings for new gene splicer related features
Added a visual effect on catching a fish
Sylvester will now visit the fish tank faster

Reorganized Lunasettings for visual clarity

New giant alien spider dialog when speaking with Kanta while considering tribute
Did some backend changes for future passive dialog. For existing saves, the first passive dialog may trigger again once.

New dialog for fishing up Proto Drake
Removed UNBOARDABLE from proto drake (oopsie, shouldn't have had that)

Made a bunch of fish easier to catch

Finished some missing dialog for the "Admonish Alysse's Antis" quest
Quest now appears at random in any bar instead of one specific location

Default splicer gene slots limit reduced to 1 (lunasettings may remain at 2 unless you change them)
Officers from cryopods can sometimes have a bonus to their gene slots
Officers from cryopods can sometimes have a bonus random splicer-exclusive skill
Increased spawn rate of empty gene splicers again for new saves

Throngler system AI changed to get impatient and use it more readily if it hasn't been used in a while while enemies are nearby
Mainly to avoid situations where it could be useful against lower power fleets but AI would hold onto it the same way overwatch players hold ult for 5 fights

Added a new exploration interaction that gives the location of most objects with cryopod officers that are in standard (non-hidden, procgen) systems
requires new save
Location can be given by Randon Meiser if not found within a few cycles, primarily spawns in high warning remnant systems

Fixed Houndslaught losing health when ending combat in detached state
Fixed crash caused by ingame adware on Linux OS
Fixed enhanced speed bonus from Giant Alien Spider skill being permanently active
Fixed double-loading of some sprites, should save a marginal amount of vram
Fixed some Threat Invictus spawn warning visual that never worked

Katamari no longer spawns in campaign due to issues with cross-mod interactions. Main menu mission unchanged.

Version 0.5.322

Fixed issue where mod would unload Alviss' portrait

Removed the funny text that would temporarily appear when you had a ship with 15 s-mods

Version 0.5.32

Hotfix.

Fixed the *** up version number

Fixed issue where Aurole hullmod fuel reduction could persist if ship is removed from fleet while active

Renamed "Zapinator Safe Mode" to "Projectile Randomization Safe Mode"
It now also effects the Ad-hoc Missile Blend hullmod to avoid a crash

Version 0.5.3.1

Hotfix for "mind over biomatter" becoming impossible to start if you find the Verdant Skin splicer before starting it

Version 0.5.3

Mostly adjustments to existing content.
There was going to be more but Palworld updated so uhh see you in a few weeks maybe

Disabled fishing objectives page while I think of something better to add

Fixed an issue with Assimilation start where an invalid dialog option would appear

Attempted to fix CTD triggered by Fenrir after it retreats if hound fighter is still alive and then clicked

Fixed a couple bugs with the Locus:
used the wrong ship explosion sound
couldn't copy modular ships due to some jank (it can do so now)

Salvage drones and sapper drones now appear as loot in certain locations (requires new save)

Salvage drones are now part of your starting cargo on the Assimilation start

Added the Stellar Rod, which can be used to fish at black holes or stars.
For existing saves if your shack development level is already 3 or higher the new item won't retroactively appear. You can use this command to get it:
Addspecial cs_bobberRedeemItem cs_stellarBobber
Then right click the given item

Added two new fish, one for black holes and one for stars, and a couple associated dishes with somewhat wackier than usual effects
These are probably the last new fish, someone had requested fishing at stars and i thought it'd be funny

Added the Black Hole, Star, and Sakura (unknown skies) fishing locales
Does the locale page need a filter like the recipe one? it's getting pretty long. let me know.

Added Dubious Disc conversion for the Champion
Dubious Disc conversion for the Mudskipper 2 now has a DP increase

Added a friendly way to recover the Archipelago
Increased maximum damage resistance of Withdraw (33% -> 50%)
Now gains a decaying timeflow bonus on each bounce during its spin attack
DP cost reduced (28 -> 24)
I honestly didn't realize how terrible this ship was, lol.
Might be overpowered now, or still bad, who knows

Adjusted spawn weights on some fish so that Ornate Rod is more effective on average

Adjusted spawn frequency for Sanctified Cores
Now spawn more consistently in fleets (usually at least 1 will appear) and heavily prefer larger hulls
No longer pilot civilian ships (no more automated salvage rigs lol)
Reduced chance of Sanctified Core piloted ships from being no auto penalty (33% -> 10%)
Reduced sell price accordingly (50k -> 20k) so you can't just farm luddic path for insane cash
Slight nerf on Absolution skill. reduced autoship outgoing/incoming bonus from 20%/15% to 15%/10%

Adjusted spawn frequency for Vulture in scavenger fleets (5 -> 8 weight)

Fishing locales and rods are now sorted by name in the fishing catalogue

Fish information is now displayed on becoming known for the first time instead of every time it's caught

Increased Cerebral Curlbeak's price and EXP to better fit its difficulty

Changed Terraprisma subsystem logic:
Instead of continuously dealing damage to anything it crosses over,
deals one larger hit of 600 Energy damage to each enemy it contacts per dive
(yes it's overpowered, still a large nerf compared to its previous 5000+ energy DPS against big enemies)

Renamed AI Switch to Integrated Automation Interchange to avoid confusion with another mod

The Longquest now doesn't lose any equipped weapons when defeated (although it may still uninstall hullmods or vents/capacitors)
Added the "Playing With Firepower" achievement
Unlocked by defeating the Longquest while it has zero unspent ordnance points on its core and most modules

Version 0.5.2

Couple attempted bug fixes for:
CTD when trying to install Wormhole Nexus

Ships added by Wormhole Nexus not appearing until you close and reopen the deploy dialog
(this is jank, so let me know if it breaks)

UI scaling issue during the "Mind over Biomatter" quest where items could become unclickable

Ground bonuses from skills such as Lobster Uprising or Meat Militia could leak into nex battles,
causing unit strengths to be abnormally high
(this has been broken for a while, but nobody noticed)

New stuff:

Assimilation custom start now has combat and salvage drones sold at any Nexus
Combat drones act as marines that take cargo space instead of personnel

salvage drones allow player to salvage some stuff even with 0 crew
They currently don't allow for surveying planets due to game limitations, but i'll try to find a way around it

Marine types added by this mod (meat militia, lobster uprising, nova sapper drones) are now usable in nex ground battles

You can no longer turn in AI cores to most people when using the Assimilation start

If using a gene splicer containing a specific skill on a specific NPC after finishing a quest a specific way,
their portrait will now be updated accordingly
(vagueposting god)

Version 0.5.1

Forum release! I hope. Team Cherry doesn't care if I use absrad, right??
Small changes before i go on break for a while

Reverted spawn rate nerf to special pre-filled splicers
Increased their base value back to 50000 mainly for forming fluid shenanigans

Unmarked Luddic Path AI core quest now gives x3 Mindjack, up from x2
Both of these changes are mainly to compensate for the new splicer use limit,
as these items were heavily limited before

Increased HP of Moon Lord's core (70000 -> 85000), eyes unchanged
Should extend 'difficult' part of the fight

Fixed Baywatcher's Bounty bug
Sand Slider now slows down time perception to make it more obvious effect is working

Fixed an issue with the radiance boss fight where sword walls from phase 1
could keep firing through the phase 2 sword rain

Added message in a bottle variant for lava worlds

Version 0.5.0-DEV-9

Gene Splicers can now add up to 2 extra skills per person
This can be adjusted in lunalib
increased the drop rate of gene splicers and reduced their sell price correspondingly

Changed Shooting Star fleet faction from Omega to Remnant to avoid campaign weirdness
(omega having comm relays is funny but looks weird)

Reduced the levels of the tinkerer and mechanic to 3
Fixed some dialog issues with the tinkerer and related missing dialog

Version 0.5.0-DEV-8

Just fixes Flourishing Fishfield not giving a fishing level bonus
and some collision issues with its shield. that's it.

Version 0.5.0-DEV-7

important - fixes a bug that could break saves

Added a short and unserious quest involving Alviss
Event appears at the crab shack at development 2+, after completing At The Gates (main quest)
speak to Alviss after the event to trigger it
partially unfinished ATM, but wanted to put out this hotfix ASAP

Marginal improvements to adware

Fixed issue with Beyond Death sometimes breaking saves
i'm not sure if this is retroactive for already broken saves, sorry
Reduced duration of fleets summoned by Beyond Death to 30 days (was 90)
Reduced fleet size (is now default max fleet size / 1.5, down to 20 from 30 by default )
Probably still overpowered

Onslaught Core fleet should no longer spawn onslaughts with higher than 35 FP
doesn't apply to existing saves
mainly to avoid spawning Overslaughts or other insanely strong modded variants

Temporarily disabled some visuals of Psycho Boost, Prophet's ship system
(I'm not 100% sure why it's sometimes freezing the game, suspecting it's this)

Added Flourishing Fishfield recipe
(This is probably the last new recipe for the time being, I just wanted to give the Mossbody another one)
Buffed the Salacious Sandslider's food, gave it a real effect
Probably fixed issue with Auto Catch not actually auto catching (i didn't test this)
Fixed issue where the refreshing shop timer would not reset, causing it to restock every month

Loot boxes should avoid picking 'meta' commodities unused in the actual game, such as ship hulls

Version 0.5.0-DEV-6

Another hotfix to avoid a vanilla crash caused by changing skill levels while the game is loading

Version 0.5.0-DEV-5

Hotfix for Longquest intel crash

Beacon of Instant Adventure now ignores stable locations

Indevo forge templates no longer drop from loot boxes

Version 0.5.0-DEV-4

Hotfix for possible save load CTD from controller hullmod

Version 0.5.0-DEV-3

Fix fishing music not playing properly

Version 0.5.0-DEV-2

Added a couple new dishes (Rejuvenating Roast, Briny Bonestorm)
Fixed a CTD with the Tropic Tandaemonium dish
More misc dialog adjustments

Version 0.5.0-DEV-1

Fix for Super Heavy Bobber glitch
Removed some unfinished dialog that was accidentally left in
Fixed some incorrect dialog
"Experiment!" button for cooking food now only creates new dishes

Version 0.5.0-DEV - Luddic Pro Fishing

NOT SAVE COMPAT WITH EARLIER VERSIONS!!!!!!!!!!
ARBITRARY VERSION NUMBER CHANGE

This update is unfinished, but I'm unlikely to finish it anytime soon.
Just releasing it while I go deal with unrelated stuff, will be back to complete it eventually
Shouldn't be that unstable, but who knows.

Known issues:
Large amounts of logging may appear in the text panel if you have devmode on. I recommend keeping it off for gameplay.
Some food buff effects are unimplemented
Has some missing dialog and descriptions
I didn't proofread this one, probably some typos too
Still crashes if Felcesis tries to invade during the Katamari bastillon fight

Reworked the fishing minigame
Added the Fishing Catalogue, which you can obtain via a short quest at the start
of the game to begin your pro fishing journey
You can use it to view fishing tips, change your rod, browse recipes, etc
Reduced the amount of waiting time before the fishing minigame starts after casting a line

Added ~30 new fish, including some "boss" fish with unique spawn conditions/locations

Fish can now have unique AI types. Some can be tough!
While some fish are not meant to be caught right at the start of a new game
(megapods, sandsliders, bosses, etc), let me know if it's too hard overall

Different planet types will have different types of fish
Fish are added to your catalogue once you hear of them or hook them once

Added recipes, which you can learn through dialog or experimentation
These combine fish to create dishes which you can feed to your officers or yourself for a temporary buff
The buff depends on which fish you use
Boss fish generally have powerful buffs that are permanent

Added quick-eat option to fleet dialog if player has any food items in cargo

Added a crab shack on Fikenhild, which accepts rare Crustlings for valuable items
Doing so also increases the crab shack's development level, unlocking new features
- fishing mini-quests to create a specific dish, catch a fish, etc
- a fish tank that will slowly make more of the fish you put in (dev. 3 or higher)
- expands the available stock for Crustling tradein

I tried to not make this a WoW rep grind, you should be able to level the shop to 3 in a reasonable amount of time
without having to 'target farm' as Crustlings will drop in most areas. Let me know if it's too slow. Or fast.

Oberon Society Card is now a tradein at the crab shack instead of being directly fished up,
and has new appropriate dialog to guide player
Removed mission_item tag from the card to allow it into the shop
(this does mean you can now sell it on accident. don't do that. unless you want to.)

Unrelated stuff:

Added Version Checker support

Added a mod guide text file attached with the mod, which lists most relevant info
such as how to start quests, where things spawn, triggers, what items do, etc
Not necessary to play the mod, only check if you dont care about spoilers
No more "what does this mod even do" questions allowed

general backend cleanup, removed stuff that was unused or not interacted with

Pirate black markets may sometimes sell ships from nearby factions they're hostile to
Ships are always sold with 0% remaining hull integrity and a large number of d-mods
Number of ships scales with pirate market size + other market size + pirate military presence

Military markets can sometimes have s-modded ships

Cultivate Mass (SiC) / BUFF skills adjusted

- No longer increase mass
- Instead directly boost damage dealt / reduce damage taken by ship collisions
- BUFF skill also makes collisions with hull/armor heal you slightly based on damage dealt

Should make the skills more effective at actually dealing damage with collisions
instead of punting enemies across the map

Loot boxes now auto-exit the dialog after a short delay once opened
mostly as a failsafe against any weird behavior that may cause a softlock

Fixed max ammo changes from Bricky Construction hullmod not applying
Added a way to reroll its stats via a npc

Added a new quest
Start via exploration or by talking to an NPC on Asher at lvl 4+

Adjustments to Splintering Fragments / threat Invictus:
- hullmod now gives a fragment at 25/30/35/40 damage taken
- threat invictus adjusted to match these values (formerly needed to take 60 damage)

Added the Bolstering Fragments hullmod, which allows you to use Threat fragments as a shield
Drops alongside splintering from threat Invictus
(threat invictus does not actually have bolstering, as i was worried it would be too annoying)

Removed Shrouded Spine (it sucked)

Removed Shock Unit (threat vanguard, generally wasn't very good and didn't add much anyway)
Beefed up the remainder of the fleet to compensate

Removed the "random ship system" super d-mod as it was breaking ***

Removed visual effect from Locus ship copy as it was also breaking ***
Fixed bug with Auric Aegis ai causing locus to use it less than intended

Onslaught Core reworked
- No longer obtained via cache
- Fleet of Onslaughts spawns in its place, commanded by Onslaught Core
- Blow it up
Drops the core along "Onslaught Core Conversion" hullmod that allows the core to
pilot any Onslaught-type capital ship for 40 OP
"Without My Consent" instead gives fleetwide bonuses to all Onslaughts, based on
how many onslaughts are present
Additional logistical bonus if fleet is purely Onslaughts
Old skill was buggy, so it was replaced by this.

Fixed a few other crashes, yada yada...

Houndslaught weapon randomization more strict to avoid picking unused weapons

Fixed issue where loading the mod into an existing save would break it

Fixed Giant Alien Spider event being overwritten by other mods

Fixed Vulture behaving weirdly with modular frigates, and being able to deploy
ships after it dies

Radiance battle now doesn't have phase slowdown from flux
Defeating the Radiance in any save now auto unlocks the Choir hullmod across all saves
Will appear once the quest "A Promise" is completed
('Void Heart' skill still requires the boss)

Adware now renders in the combat layer

Planula nerf

Slight nerf to Diamond Back hullmod:
- damage resistance to non-Energy types reduced to 15%
- armor bonus reduced to +20%
Still overpowered.

Cut back scope creep on Proto Drake, no longer has swappable systems/weapons
Can be obtained via fishing
Removed hidden faction to avoid *** with other mods

Intel that only exists to tell you the location of something no longer automatically disappears once you find said thing
you can still delete it manually if you wish
Added the "INTEL_EXPLORATION" tag to these types of intel
(includes intel for Radiance quest, intel for houndslaught, katamari, etc)
Also added more of this type of intel for exploration content that didn't have any leads
Includes LOCUS, enforcer XIV derelict, Shooting Star

Added an option during Shooting Star to just take the item if you own the colony instead of having to raid/buy it
(i didn't actually test this, so let me know if it's broken)

System Swap hullmod now has an OP cost (8/12/20/30)
Added the System Processing Override item (experimental)
- Spawns rarely in procgen if experimental mods is enabled
- Contain sequences for ship system information for random hullsizes
- Use to learn the ship system for that hullsize
Essentially exists as a way to learn ship systems outside of disassembly,
allowing the possibility for learning "illegal" combinations (e.g. mine strike destroyer)
that you might not have access to in your game, provided you're lucky enough to find the right one
Might be removed if it turns out to be too buggy

Experimental design type renamed to Experimental-C to avoid overlap with other mods

Mega Hound hullmod now displays fighter flux diss

Removed a bunch of unused sounds

Automated Teller adjustment:
Cargo space reduced to 3000 (was 5000)
Weapons/LPCs stored now use 50% of their normal storage space
Should be more useful for refitting without bailing you out of supply issues as easily
Made the cache that spawns during the quest more noisy if you don't pick the SP option,
and made it spawn closer to the center of the system
(previously it could spawn on a map border and be too far to be heard)

Squished system swap UI a bit more so it functions on lower resolutions

Added the Mindjack, a gene splicer for ai cores
If you saw some modded core with a cool skill you wanted, there you go
Replaces the Prometheus mk.II reward from the luddic cores quest
Altered some of the dialog for that quest

Gene splicers now maintain the level of the input skill
Splicers found pre-filled can still have their skills elite by default
Slightly reduced spawn rate, spawns 4 unique skills on sector gen instead of 6
Gene splicers now display the held skill when the tooltip is expanded
Hidden skills become known if used once and no longer display the warning icon

Throngler now removes bullet time if being hit with its ship system would slow the player's time down
Mainly to avoid situations where high modded timeflow amounts can cause the game to run extremely slowly

After assembling the Longquest fully, the sequence no longer auto scrolls
Made Longquest intel not direct you to arms you already salvaged,
default location is now Staging Site SK1-0N to keep track of it

Implemented "Prophet" ship, still somewhat unfinished atm but is obtainable via magicbounty
notably lacks a custom system AI as of now

You can now show your giant alien spider to alviss

Added more variations of the end-of-month flavor text for any Giant Alien Spider's paycheck

Probably other small tweaks i forgot about

An unserious mod that contains whatever I happened to think was funny at the moment. Has quests, ships with weird mechanics, lots of dialog, special items, boss fights, exploration content, fishing, etc...
A non-exhaustive list of previews below

Exploration stuff
Spoiler
Fall into the trap of a deadly Houndslaught, gain an unlikely ally after defeating a colony of giant alien spiders, use metamorphic fluid to duplicate said ally, respond to an ancient distress signal to aid in combat against an abyssal threat, or accidentally install adware onto your Tripad. The possibilities are... rather limited, actually. But there's a decent amount of stuff.
Gene Splicers
Spoiler
Find Gene Splicers out in the fringes, which let you move skills between officers. Some even come pre-filled!

... but be careful, don't just do any drugs you find lying around. Not all the skills they have are good!
Giant Alien Spiders
Spoiler
Giant alien spiders are no joke! Fortunately, your marines are professionals and have no time for jokes.
Just what would happen if you kept this egg around?
Strange Canisters
Spoiler
Might want the PPE on for this one.
Other varying self-contained encounters as small setpieces






... and more!

Fishing
Spoiler
Adds a fishing minigame with associated systems. You can learn to fish at Fikenhild.

Look at your fishing catalogue to plan your excursion, fish the fish, and cook them into one of many unique meals with custom effects.

Or maybe you just want to watch them swim around in your fish tank at the end of a long day?

Ships
SpoilerArchipelago
Spoiler
Some advertisement drone that exists as one of the only remnants of a corporation that fell apart after the Collapse.
Rumored to be spotted in the fringes nearby water worlds.

Can operate unmanned, but comes with onboard vomit buckets in the event it's piloted by a captain. Hold on tight!
Houndslaught
Spoiler
Fourty hounds strong with a nasty bite. Able to disperse its Hound modules like a swarm of bats to reposition as needed.

Comes with an Alex-approved Alviss version.
Fenrir
Spoiler
Too many hounds? I understand. Here's something more reasonable.
Ziggurat Mk.I
Spoiler
Horrific love child of an onslaught and a certain phase ship. Maybe you can get it by talking to a certain Company director while its parents are in your fleet?
Longquest

FAQ

Can it be added to existing saves?
Yes. Some things may behave strangely if added very late into a playthrough, but nothing game breaking.

How do I engage with the content?
Just do whatever you normally do. There's no central faction or big feature of the mod that demands attention... but if you don't like that answer, explore the fringes, check bars, maybe stop by Fikenhild?
There's also a mod guide attached that has steps on how to find (almost) everything, if you don't care for spoilers.

Is this mod balanced?
Not at all!

Unserious? How bad is it?
Yes. Basically the Wild Wasteland of starsector. This is firmly a meme mod. If you value immersion, don't install this.

Is this mod finished?
No. The current features are relatively complete, although you might run into missing dialog here and there. It'll work on it as I can.

Stability?
The mod shouldn't cause notable lag, I run a profiler on everything. Crashes should be fairly unlikely, but I may have missed some cross-mod wonk.

TriOS says the mod uses 8 billion megabytes of VRAM!
Yeah. The mod loads and unloads sprites as needed, so the actual usage won't be as high. A specific boss fight listed above is responsible for this. if you're skirting your VRAM limit as is you may be unable to fight that boss.
Typical vram usage for the mod is ~200 megabytes
